subject.title: [Bug]: keyless WebIQ search disables secrets runtime fast path

question: Should the secrets fast path trust the proposed generic `provider` plus matching `omitAuth: true` configuration shape as sufficient evidence that web search is credential-free?
rationale: This changes the conservative boundary deciding whether startup may skip full SecretRef and web-tool preparation; tests can cover known shapes, but maintainers must confirm the permanent trust contract for third-party plugin configuration.

options.title: Approve narrow fail-closed bypass
options.body: Accept the generic keyless shape only after unrelated changes are split and live startup proof confirms all credential-bearing and ambiguous cases remain on the resolver path.

options.title: Keep all plugin search on resolver
options.body: Preserve the current conservative behavior and accept the startup cost whenever plugin web-search configuration is present.

options.title: Require an explicit plugin contract
options.body: Replace config-shape inference with a plugin metadata or secret-contract signal before allowing third-party search providers onto the fast path.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow fail-closed bypass
recommendation.body: Accept the generic keyless shape only after unrelated changes are split and live startup proof confirms all credential-bearing and ambiguous cases remain on the resolver path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced and expanded the secrets runtime contract that this exception would modify.
